scope: Schema, constraints, row counts and applied migration names; no application records or credentials.

activo_alerta.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "activo_alerta" ("activo_id" integer not null, "alerta_id" integer not null, foreign key("activo_id") references "activos"("id") on delete cascade, foreign key("alerta_id") references "alertas"("id") on delete cascade, primary key ("activo_id", "alerta_id"))

activo_ubicaciones.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "activo_ubicaciones" ("activo_id" integer not null, "piso" varchar, "sala" varchar, foreign key("activo_id") references "activos"("id") on delete cascade, primary key ("activo_id"))

activos.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "activos" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "categoria_id" integer not null, "serial" varchar not null, "descripcion" text not null, "estado_activo" varchar not null, "fecha_alta" date not null, "frecuencia_service" integer not null, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, "ubicacion" varchar, foreign key("categoria_id") references "categorias_activo"("id") on delete restrict)

alertas.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "alertas" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "nivel_alerta" varchar not null, "tipo_alerta" varchar not null, "fecha_generacion" datetime not null, "estado_alerta" varchar not null default 'Pendiente', "urgencia" varchar check ("urgencia" in ('Critico', 'Alto', 'Medio', 'Bajo')) not null default 'Medio', "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime)

asset_map_positions.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "asset_map_positions" ("activo_id" integer not null, "floor" varchar not null, "room" varchar not null, "x" double not null, "z" double not null, "elevation" double not null default '0', "rotation" double not null default '0', "updated_by" integer, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("activo_id") references "activos"("id") on delete cascade, foreign key("updated_by") references "usuarios"("id") on delete set null, primary key ("activo_id"))

auditorias.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "auditorias" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "fecha_auditoria" datetime not null, "descripcion" text not null)

cache.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "cache" ("key" varchar not null, "value" text not null, "expiration" integer not null, primary key ("key"))

cache_locks.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "cache_locks" ("key" varchar not null, "owner" varchar not null, "expiration" integer not null, primary key ("key"))

categorias_activo.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "categorias_activo" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "nombre" varchar not null, "descripcion" text, "requiere_consumible" tinyint(1) not null default '0', "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime)

consumibles.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "consumibles" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "activo_id" integer not null, "nombre" varchar not null, "tipo" varchar not null, "nivel" numeric not null default '100', "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("activo_id") references "activos"("id") on delete cascade)

failed_jobs.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "failed_jobs" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "uuid" varchar not null, "connection" varchar not null, "queue" varchar not null, "payload" text not null, "exception" text not null, "failed_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

jefe_nombres.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "jefe_nombres" ("jefe_id" integer not null, "nombre" varchar not null, "apellido" varchar, foreign key("jefe_id") references "jefes_tecnicos"("id") on delete cascade, primary key ("jefe_id"))

jefes_tecnicos.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "jefes_tecnicos" ("id" integer not null, "nombre_completo" varchar not null, primary key ("id"))

job_batches.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "job_batches" ("id" varchar not null, "name" varchar not null, "total_jobs" integer not null, "pending_jobs" integer not null, "failed_jobs" integer not null, "failed_job_ids" text not null, "options" text, "cancelled_at" integer, "created_at" integer not null, "finished_at" integer, primary key ("id"))

jobs.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "jobs" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "queue" varchar not null, "payload" text not null, "attempts" integer not null, "reserved_at" integer, "available_at" integer not null, "created_at" integer not null)

mantenimientos.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "mantenimientos" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "activo_id" integer not null, "reporte_id" integer, "fecha_mantenimiento" date not null, "descripcion" text not null, "observaciones" text, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("activo_id") references "activos"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("reporte_id") references "reportes"("id") on delete set null)

migrations.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "migrations" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "migration" varchar not null, "batch" integer not null)

password_reset_tokens.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "password_reset_tokens" ("email" varchar not null, "token" varchar not null, "created_at" datetime, primary key ("email"))

reporte_activo.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "reporte_activo" ("reporte_id" integer not null, "activo_id" integer not null, foreign key("reporte_id") references "reportes"("id") on delete cascade, foreign key("activo_id") references "activos"("id") on delete restrict, primary key ("reporte_id", "activo_id"))

reportes.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "reportes" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "jefe_id" integer, "auditoria_id" integer, "historial" text, "estado_reporte" varchar not null default 'Abierto', "urgencia" varchar check ("urgencia" in ('Critico', 'Alto', 'Medio', 'Bajo')) not null default 'Medio', "descripcion" text not null, "fecha_creacion" datetime not null, "fecha_cierre" datetime, "resolucion" text, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, "informe_accionar" text, "diagnostico_final" text, foreign key("jefe_id") references "jefes_tecnicos"("id") on delete set null, foreign key("auditoria_id") references "auditorias"("id") on delete set null)

sessions.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "sessions" ("id" varchar not null, "user_id" integer, "ip_address" varchar, "user_agent" text, "payload" text not null, "last_activity" integer not null, primary key ("id"))

tareas_calendario.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "tareas_calendario" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "fecha" date not null, "hora" varchar not null default '09:00', "titulo" varchar not null, "tipo" varchar not null default 'mantenimiento', "category" varchar not null default 'Mantenimiento', "technician_id" integer, "technician_name" varchar, "asset_id" integer, "asset_code" varchar, "priority" varchar not null default 'Media', "completed" tinyint(1) not null default '0', "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("technician_id") references "usuarios"("id") on delete set null, foreign key("asset_id") references "activos"("id") on delete set null)

tecnico_jefe_tecnico.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "tecnico_jefe_tecnico" ("tecnico_id" integer not null, "jefe_id" integer not null, "reporte_id" integer not null, "fecha_asignacion" datetime not null, "fecha_finalizacion" datetime, "motivo_reasignacion" text, foreign key("tecnico_id") references "tecnicos"("id") on delete cascade, foreign key("jefe_id") references "jefes_tecnicos"("id") on delete cascade, foreign key("reporte_id") references "reportes"("id") on delete cascade, primary key ("tecnico_id", "jefe_id", "reporte_id", "fecha_asignacion"))

tecnicos.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "tecnicos" ("id" integer not null, "tipo_tecnico" varchar check ("tipo_tecnico" in ('Hardware', 'Software', 'Redes/Infraestructura')) not null, primary key ("id"))

usuario_direcciones.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "usuario_direcciones" ("usuario_id" integer not null, "calle" varchar, "numero_calle" varchar, foreign key("usuario_id") references "usuarios"("id") on delete cascade, primary key ("usuario_id"))

usuario_nombres.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "usuario_nombres" ("usuario_id" integer not null, "nombre" varchar not null, "apellido" varchar, foreign key("usuario_id") references "usuarios"("id") on delete cascade, primary key ("usuario_id"))

usuario_reporte.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "usuario_reporte" ("usuario_id" integer not null, "reporte_id" integer not null, foreign key("usuario_id") references "usuarios"("id") on delete cascade, foreign key("reporte_id") references "reportes"("id") on delete cascade, primary key ("usuario_id", "reporte_id"))

usuarios.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "usuarios" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "cedula" varchar, "email" varchar not null, "rol" varchar check ("rol" in ('Administrador', 'Empleado')) not null, "numero_telefono" varchar, "password" varchar not null, "activo" tinyint(1) not null default '1', "remember_token" varchar, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, "nombre_completo" varchar, "direccion" varchar)
